groups.label: Production Incidents
groups.description: Outages, slowdowns, and oh-no Tuesdays from real ops war stories.

groups.label: Deploys & Releases
groups.description: Deployments, rollbacks, schema migrations, and config-change pain.

groups.label: External Threats
groups.description: Attacks, exploits, and unwanted attention from the internet.

groups.label: Insider & Abuse
groups.description: Departing employees, off-policy access, and misuse from inside the perimeter.

groups.label: Cloud & Identity
groups.description: IAM, OIDC, SaaS, and identity-edge mistakes on AWS / Entra / Okta / GitHub.

scenarios.title: Database Slowdown Cascade
scenarios.description: Postgres slow queries cascade into API degradation; replica failover restores service.

scenarios.title: Cache Failure Cascade
scenarios.description: Redis OOM forces reads onto Postgres; pool exhausts; APIs degrade until cache recovers.

scenarios.title: Internal DNS Resolver Outage
scenarios.description: Corp Unbound dies after a config push; downstream apps can't resolve internal SRV records and fail health checks.

scenarios.title: Wildcard Cert Expired at 03:14 UTC
scenarios.description: Wildcard renewed in Vault but never re-deployed; edge TLS and east-west mTLS both break.

scenarios.title: Disk Full From Runaway Debug Logs
scenarios.description: DEBUG-mode logging fills the data partition on a legacy MySQL; binlogs stop, DB goes read-only.

scenarios.title: Kafka Broker Loss → Election Storm
scenarios.description: Flaky NIC drops a broker; partition leader elections push produce p99 to seconds and consumers fall behind.

scenarios.title: Connection Pool Exhaustion
scenarios.description: A slow third-party tax API holds open HikariCP connections; pool saturates and the LB ejects an instance.

scenarios.title: NTP Drift Breaks Authentication
scenarios.description: ESXi host loses NTP sync; VMs drift forward; JWT and Kerberos tickets start being rejected.

scenarios.title: JVM Memory Leak Death Spiral
scenarios.description: Subtle leak in a Caffeine cache key causes GC pauses to climb until OOM, then cascades to peer replicas.

scenarios.title: NLB Cross-Zone Imbalance
scenarios.description: Cross-zone load balancing accidentally disabled; one AZ takes 75% of the traffic and saturates.

scenarios.title: Bad Canary Deploy
scenarios.description: Canary fails health checks; LB shifts traffic and the rest of the fleet absorbs the load until rollback.

scenarios.title: Online Schema Migration Deadlock
scenarios.description: Migration blocks behind a stale SELECT FOR UPDATE; metadata lock wedges every INSERT to orders.

scenarios.title: Feature Flag Flip Storms Downstream
scenarios.description: Flag flipped 5%→100% quadruples DB query rate and starves an unrelated service that shares the database.

scenarios.title: Helm Image Tag Typo → CrashLoopBackOff
scenarios.description: values.yaml references a tag that doesn't exist; rolling update breaks every replica until rollback.

scenarios.title: Config Drift Blows Up Terraform Apply
scenarios.description: Hand-edited SG rule reconciled away by IaC; partner integration breaks until the rule is reinstated.

scenarios.title: DNS Cutover With Bad TTL
scenarios.description: Cutover honoured a 24h TTL; half the user base hits the decommissioned old edge for hours.

scenarios.title: Forgotten Cron on a 12-Year-Old Host
scenarios.description: Disk on a long-forgotten RHEL 6 cron host fails; nightly close pipeline misses for the first time in nine years.

scenarios.title: Rollback Hits Non-Reversible Migration
scenarios.description: Rollback target's code expects a table the migration already DROPPED; cluster ends up in mixed state.

scenarios.title: Third-Party SDK Auto-Bump Breaks API
scenarios.description: Renovate-merged 'minor' bump silently changes an auth header; every IdP call returns 401.

scenarios.title: Autoscaler Lags a Black Friday Ramp
scenarios.description: Promo emails ramp traffic 20x in 5 minutes; HPA + pod warm-up are slower than the spike.

scenarios.title: DDoS at the Edge
scenarios.description: L7 flood saturates the edge LB; downstream APIs throttle, attack subsides, traffic normalises.

scenarios.title: Credential Stuffing → Account Takeover
scenarios.description: Brute force on auth-api breaks through; lateral movement and bulk PII reads before containment.

scenarios.title: Log4Shell Probe & Successful Exploit
scenarios.description: Mass jndi: payloads land in headers; one forgotten Tomcat with log4j 2.14 makes the outbound LDAP call.

scenarios.title: SQL Injection on Legacy Form
scenarios.description: Boolean-blind SQLi against a 2014-era ColdFusion partner portal exfils the partners table over 12 minutes.

scenarios.title: Web Shell Drop via Image Uploader
scenarios.description: Polyglot .jpg/.phtml upload through a permissive uploader; static-assets pod ends up executing the shell.

scenarios.title: Illicit OAuth Consent Grant
scenarios.description: Phishing tricks finance staff into consenting to a Mail.Read app; attacker pulls inboxes via Graph.

scenarios.title: Cryptojacking in Forgotten K8s Pod
scenarios.description: Open NodePort + cluster-admin SA → attacker schedules an xmrig pod; CPU pegs and noisy-neighbours app.

scenarios.title: Tor Exit Nodes Scraping Pricing
scenarios.description: Distributed Tor scraping dodges per-IP rate limits; replica lag grows as the cache churns.

scenarios.title: Public S3 Bucket Discovered & Drained
scenarios.description: World-readable backup bucket from 2022 enumerated and drained; GuardDuty fires on anonymous reads.

scenarios.title: Subdomain Takeover via Dangling CNAME
scenarios.description: Attacker claims a deleted Heroku app behind shop-old.acme.io and serves a near-perfect phishing clone.

scenarios.title: Departing Engineer — Bulk Pull
scenarios.description: Engineer two weeks from leaving clones 87 repos and pulls 14 GB from SharePoint on their last day.

scenarios.title: HR Analyst Snooping on Exec Files
scenarios.description: Authorised account opens 27 C-suite comp files at 1 AM Sunday — every action is technically allowed.

scenarios.title: Service Account Used Interactively
scenarios.description: Backup service account suddenly authenticates with Logon Type 10 (RemoteInteractive) — never seen before.

scenarios.title: Customer DB Exfil to Personal Gmail
scenarios.description: 37k-row customer CSV emailed to a personal Gmail; DLP rule was set to monitor-only.

scenarios.title: Honeytoken Tripped on Finance Share
scenarios.description: Canary M&A document opened from a vendor laptop VLAN at 02:47 — first solid lead on a 31-day dwell intrusion.

scenarios.title: After-Hours Admin Activity Spike
scenarios.description: Admin makes 280 prod config changes at 02:30 Sunday — could be IR, could be the admin, could be someone else.

scenarios.title: Sales Rep Mass-Exporting CRM
scenarios.description: AE pulls 'Lead Lists by Region' 532 times in five days, then accepts an offer at a competitor.

scenarios.title: Mass MFA Disable from Helpdesk Console
scenarios.description: Helpdesk session resets MFA on 41 VIPs in 30 minutes right before a phishing wave.

scenarios.title: Shadow IT SaaS Wired Into Corp SSO
scenarios.description: Unsanctioned Notion workspace grows to 142 corp users; CASB risk score finally trips a review.

scenarios.title: PCI Segment Violation
scenarios.description: Developer SSHes from CDE jump host to a non-CDE Elasticsearch — PCI-DSS doesn't care about intent.

scenarios.title: SSRF → IMDSv1 → Stolen EC2 Creds
scenarios.description: Image-resize SSRF reaches 169.254.169.254 with IMDSv1; role credentials used from a residential IP.

scenarios.title: IAM PrivEsc via PassRole
scenarios.description: Low-priv user with iam:PassRole + lambda:CreateFunction chains to admin via a self-invoked Lambda.

scenarios.title: IdP Support Session Theft
scenarios.description: Lapsus$-style: vendor support session compromised; password resets and factor enrolment from IdP infra IPs.

scenarios.title: GitHub PAT Leaked in CI Log
scenarios.description: set -x echoes a long-lived PAT into a public log; scraped within 90s, used for repo cloning + deploy key.

scenarios.title: Azure AD Pass-the-PRT
scenarios.description: Infostealer pulls PRT cookie + transport key from a laptop; Graph access without MFA from a new device.

scenarios.title: AWS Root Login From New Geo
scenarios.description: Root account dormant 411 days suddenly logs in, opens billing, mints an access key.

scenarios.title: Rogue Global Admin Service Principal
scenarios.description: Break-glass GA consents to a 'BackupTool' app; new SP gets Global Admin within an hour.

scenarios.title: Conditional Access Weakened 'For Testing'
scenarios.description: CA policy disabled to debug an integration and forgotten; spray + BEC forwarding rules follow hours later.

scenarios.title: Stale Cross-Account Trust Abused
scenarios.description: Defunct vendor's AWS account purchased at auction; pre-existing trust used to assume a prod role.

scenarios.title: GitHub Actions OIDC Trust Too Loose
scenarios.description: Trust policy with repo:acme/* lets a fork-PR runner assume the prod deploy role.
